user.title: Add a display panel
user.description: Choose a panel ID matching the display setup. After adding the integration, use Configure to select your entities.

error.invalid_panel_id: Use 1–24 lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.

abort.already_configured: This panel ID is already configured.

init.title: Edit the display
init.description: Changes are sent to the physical display and dashboard card automatically.

row.title: Reading {slot}
row.description: Choose a source. To show a temperature difference, select flow as Source and return as Subtract. Leave Unit override blank to use the source unit. Labels and values also appear on the dashboard.

weather.title: Weather page
weather.description: The non-touch screen alternates between readings and weather. Select the weather provider and the connected temperature sensor. Forecasts are refreshed every 15 minutes. Rain timing is shown when the provider supports hourly forecasts.

error.weather_required: Select a weather entity before enabling the weather page.
